findings.message: The grouping ((brahma-veda)-(sva-rūpa)) is defensible, but the evidence also supports (brahma)-(veda-svarūpa), 'Brahman, who has the Veda as his form' (sanskritdocuments-rudra8.md English; gitapress-ramcharitmanas.md prints 'ब्रह्म वेदस्वरूपं' as two words, gloss 'ब्रह्म और वेदस्वरूप'). w5.notes cites Gita Press for the dvandva when it more likely backs the other grouping. A human should decide which grouping goes first.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the alternative grouping to compounds.c2.note and reword w5.notes.
